exposure: Thyroid function status (hypothyroid, hyperthyroid, IHT, history of thyroid carcinoma, euthyroid)
outcome: History of previous lower segment cesarean section
Early preterm delivery before 34 weeks of gestation
cohort: All births delivered in Malta between 2006 and 2016
finding: Thyroid dysfunction in pregnancy is associated with older age, higher BMI, and impacts neonatal birth weight, rates of early preterm delivery, and intrauterine growth restriction.
mod_finding: No significant differences in mode of delivery were observed between women with and without thyroid dysfunction.
